name: @quarry/forge-server
description: The Forge service (docs/design/architecture-split.md, phase 3): recipes, builds and their jobs, in a process of its own, on its own database login. Datasets through Catalog's microservice calls, job tokens through Identity's. Browsers reach it through the main server; ForgeAgents call its /api/forge-agent endpoints directly.

scripts.dev: nodemon -w src -w ../../../platform/kernel -w ../../../libraries/shared -e ts,json --exec ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/main.ts
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
